info.name: BookX — Full API Test Suite
info.description:
Complete end-to-end test collection for BookX microservices.

Run order:
1. 🔐 Auth
2. 🧹 Pre-Run Cleanup
3. 🎬 Admin Shows Management
4. 🔄 Sync Shows → BookXShow
5. 🎭 Browse Shows (User)
6. 🎟️ Booking Flow (book, cancel, rebook)
7. 🔒 Security Violation Tests
8. 🛠️ M2M Client Management
9. 📊 S2S Read Endpoints (Admin)
10. 🗑️ Admin Show Lifecycle — Cancel
11. ✅ Health Checks
12. 🧹 Post-Run Cleanup

Environment: BookX — Local

item.name: 🧹 Pre-Run Cleanup
item.description:
Deletes any data left over from a previous interrupted test run — runs AFTER Auth (tokens required) but BEFORE any data-creation steps. Idempotent: all requests accept 'not found' or 'already done' responses gracefully.

What is cleaned:
• postman-test-client M2M client (hard delete)
• Admin shows from prior run IDs stored in env vars (soft cancel)

What CANNOT be cleaned (no delete API):
• app_users (bookx_user1, bookx_user2) — Sign Up tests handle this by accepting 201 or 409
• BookXShow shows/seats/bookings rows

exec: if (status === 204) { console.log('🧹 Cleaned up leftover M2M client: ' + pm.environment.get('newM2mClientId')); }
else { console.log('ℹ️  M2M client did not exist — clean slate'); }

item.name: 🔒 Security Violation Tests
item.description: All requests below should return 403 Forbidden. Verifies that security fixes are working correctly.

item.name: [403] GET Admin Shows with User Token

exec: pm.test('Status 403 — userToken cannot access admin shows', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

exec: pm.test('Status 403 — userToken cannot trigger admin sync', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

exec: pm.test('Status 403 — User 2 cannot read User 1 bookings', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
